scripts.build: npm --workspace=apps/api run build && npm --workspace=apps/web run build
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm --workspace=apps/api run dev" "npm --workspace=apps/web run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others --names bridge,dev --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run codex:bridge:dev" "npm run dev"
scripts.start:all: concurrently --kill-others --names bridge,dashboard --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run codex:bridge" "docker compose up --build"
scripts.test: npm --workspace=apps/api run test && npm --workspace=apps/web run test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --workspace=apps/api run test:coverage && npm --workspace=apps/web run test:coverage
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=apps/api run typecheck && npm --workspace=apps/web run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run format:check && npm run build
